units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:11">Ab. IV, 11</cite> <he>העובר … קונה לו ק׳ אחד</he> he who commits one sin, acquires one prosecutor for himself, opp. <cite ref="Q02004"><he>פרקליט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:2">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>עלה קָטֵיגוֹרוֹ וכ׳</he> his (Solomon’s) accuser (before the Lord) arose &c.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 2:3">Ab. d’R. N. ch. II</cite> <he>קושרין ק׳</he>, read: <cite ref="S00740"><he>קָטֵיגוֹרְיָא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>קָטֵיגוֹרִים</he>, <he>קָטֵיגוֹרִין</he>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> <he>וק׳ עומדים לפניך … קטיגוריא</he> (not <he>רים …</he>) the accusers stand before thee, and the advocates stand before thee, these pleading in our favor, and those bringing charges against us.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:3:5">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 8:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. VIII, 2</cite> <he>בכל יום הייתם ק׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (ed. <cite ref="S00741"><he>קטיגטין</he></cite>, corr. acc.) at all times you have been accusers (creating mischief) between me and Israel; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:5">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, beg. <he>הגיע ק׳</he> some ed., read: <cite ref="S00740"><he>קָטֵיגוֹרְיָא</he></cite>.
